title: Bolt's Beat
logline: A shy robot named Bolt overcomes his inhibitions and finds joy on the dance floor at a lively rooftop party.
theme: Overcoming shyness, self-expression, the joy of dance

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A small, shy service robot with an internal longing to dance.

characters.name: Maya
characters.one_line_description: A warm and friendly human who notices Bolt's shyness and offers encouragement.

characters.name: DJ Spark
characters.one_line_description: A sleek, energetic robot DJ who keeps the party's energy high with his music.

scenes.title: Awkward Arrival
scenes.summary: Bolt stands awkwardly at the edge of a vibrant rooftop party, observing the dancing but too shy to join in.
scenes.setting: A bustling rooftop party at sunset, with colorful lights and a vibrant crowd.

scenes.title: Watching the Groove
scenes.summary: Bolt watches the partygoers and DJ Spark dancing with longing, his internal gears whirring with imagined moves.
scenes.setting: Near the dance floor, close to DJ Spark's booth.

scenes.title: A Friendly Nudge
scenes.summary: Maya approaches Bolt, smiling warmly, and gently encourages him to join the dancing, offering her hand.
scenes.setting: The periphery of the dance floor.

scenes.title: First Steps
scenes.summary: With Maya's encouragement, Bolt takes a tentative step onto the dance floor, trying a small, stiff movement that quickly loosens.
scenes.setting: The edge of the dance floor, with other partygoers.

scenes.title: Dancing Free
scenes.summary: Bolt fully embraces the music, moving with unexpected grace and joy, as Maya and others cheer him on, and DJ Spark drops a perfect beat.
scenes.setting: Center of the dance floor, under the party lights.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
